card.title: SDF
card.text: Your other units have +1 attack for each of your Guard units.
card.flavorText: During WWII, Sudan was under British and Egyptian joint control, known as the Anglo-Egyptian Sudan. The Sudan Defence Force was formed in 1925 and was a locally raised military force composed of Sudanese personnel, but led by the British. During WWII the SDF was expanded to 25,000 officers and men, and from 1940, they participated in the East African Campaign. They defended against Italian forces in Sudan and contributed to the successful invasion of Eritrea in 1941. The SDF also played a crucial role in the Western Desert Campaign where they were used to resupply the Free French and the Long Range Desert Group (LRDG) in Libya. In 1942 during the North African Campaign, the SDF was successfully used in operations aimed at intercepting German Brandenburger commando’s infiltration into Egypt. After the Allied victory in the Tunisian Campaign, the SDF continued patrolling and countering German efforts behind enemy lines. By the war's end, the SDF had evolved into an experienced military unit, and Sudanese officers began replacing British officers in the years leading up to the country's independence.
